source_job_power: source-matched canonical Kestrel work plus measured H100 utilization-power p95 envelope
work_unit: normalized full-utilization H100-equivalent GPU-hour, not FLOPs/tokens
fast_optimization_authority: actual deterministic Gurobi continuous convex QP with per-IDC GPU and MESS SOC constraints; nominal Q is fixed at zero and only each method's preregistered MESS P/Q capability may be used by its AC-safety projection; no common emergency MESS dispatch exists
gurobi_numerical_acceptance: finite primal with OPTIMAL or SUBOPTIMAL status; a raw MaxVio above 1e-6 triggers one deterministic NumericFocus/ScaleFlag retry, followed by exact bound and per-site capacity projection with independently verified residual <=1e-9; every commit still requires Fresh Exact AC
common_hard_safety_actuator: B0-B7 share the same hard limits, native feeder-device controller, and capability-bounded reactive support from the existing phase-resolved PV generators. Scheduled MESS and workload optimization remain restricted to each arm's preregistered capability
overvoltage_control_direction: for capability-enabled arms, absorb inverter Q, charge MESS when thermal headroom permits, and increase temporal compute within remaining-work, robust GPU-reserve, and unchanged 750-kVA limits; workload throttling is reserved for undervoltage or thermal relief
predictive_native_dwell_guard: When a dwell-admissible local capacitor transition is proposed, every subset of that simultaneous transition is screened over the next twelve causal five-minute q90-background/q10-PV forecast steps. Existing RegControls are reevaluated at every forecast step, the capacitor candidate is held for the forecast dwell window, and only a current realized-h0 Fresh-exact passing action may be selected. Future actual is prohibited in production; actual-future reachability is confined to the separately imported offline oracle module. Existing current-state global search, method-scoped projection, deep restoration, scale, ratings, assets, and hard limits remain unchanged.
common_native_grid_control: COMMON_NATIVE_GRID_VOLT_VAR_CONTROL_V1 carries capacitor and regulator tap states chronologically. It first applies local CapControl/RegControl and a bounded feeder-wide discrete guard, after which each method receives only its preregistered continuous projection. If all remain Fresh-exact infeasible, finite-difference integer tap restoration searches the existing native assets. PV reactive power is disabled because the frozen PV authority defines peak-available kW rather than inverter kVA. FEEDER_ABSOLUTE_SCALE_CONTRACT_V2 applies one common p100-based factor to background P/Q/PV in both causal planning and exact execution. No emergency MESS, load shedding, rating increase, or hard-limit relaxation is introduced. The design is frozen for January-2025 post-hoc development and unseen-period validation.
continuous_ac_projection_acceptance: the primary finite-difference joint P/Q subproblem is an elastic convex feasibility-restoration trust-region QCP, so an initially infeasible point may take strictly improving intermediate steps across more than one trust radius; every step is relinearized from Fresh exact results and final acceptance remains exclusively the unchanged 0.95/1.05/1.0 Fresh OpenDSS hard limits
mess_operational_policy: only energy-enabled methods may use nominal MESS P; dispatch and mobility must preserve the 440-kWh protected floor while each independent daily episode cold-starts at 760 kWh
missing_input_bytes_policy: raw input_bytes remains NULL and is never zero-filled; the frozen primary migration case study separately declares datasets pre-staged at all 12 IDCs, so destination dataset transfer is zero by scenario authority rather than by imputation
checkpoint_policy: checkpoint size and interval are not measured in Kestrel; IDC_MIGRATION_AUTHORITY_V1 explicitly models a 30-minute interval, rho_ckpt times requested-GPU count times an 80-GB H100-framebuffer engineering reference, and one five-minute simulation interval of restart overhead. The primary rho_ckpt is 1.0 and January development sensitivity values are 0.25, 0.5, and 1.0; none is a measured checkpoint size
migration_authority: PFR_IDC_MIGRATION_ABILENE12_H10080_V1; Abilene is a 12-node capacity benchmark and must not be described as a measured Melbourne inter-IDC WAN
future_actual: prohibited; current h0 realized physical state is allowed only inside Fresh OpenDSS
